orientation.task: Narrative writing creative quality: apply resource learning to story revision with provenance and completion checks
orientation.expansion_rule: Expand context only when a material evidence gap, authority conflict, failed test, or cross-domain dependency appears.
orientation.execution_rule: Resolve an existing roadmap/task before creating a new one. Do not serialize every lifecycle phase into a separate planning pass. Collapse compatible work and move to execution once the minimum authoritative context is sufficient.

intent.input: /bullpen mission Narrative writing creative quality: apply resource learning to story revision with provenance and completion checks

route.task: Narrative writing creative quality: apply resource learning to story revision with provenance and completion checks

counterweight_plan.failure_mode: narrative coherence becoming stronger than evidentiary truth
challenge_questions: What is the verified event spine?
Which statements are interpretation rather than fact?
Did creative framing alter causality or history?
preflight: build the fact spine before prose
during: keep creative framing subordinate to the event spine
postflight: reconcile narrative claims against evidence and provenance

tension.name: Claim Provenance
tension.principle: Every meaningful factual claim must know where it came from.
